summary: Your system is heavily skewed toward LONG bias with strong edge when momentum (MACD positive) and trend strength (ADX>25) align with directional dominance (DI+ >35). Critical failure: trading LONG into strongly bearish sentiment (≤-0.30) produces 90% loss rate and should be auto-blocked. SHORT trades fail 87% of the time and should be avoided. DNE signal miss rate of 23.8% suggests moderate conservatism—acceptable given the poor risk/reward of forced entries.
